title: Segregation, Separation and Survivability
description: Segregation, Separation and Survivability as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are segregation needs between the installation and other Systems identified?
Are redundant items that must be separated identified?
Are survivability or damage tolerance needs identified?
Are fuel lines segregated from electrical looms by at least the minimum separation, or shielded?
Are redundant paths separated so that a single event cannot affect both?
Are zonal hazards (fluid leaks, fire, debris) assessed against the layout?
Are segregation distances confirmed in the integrated model?
Are segregation features (shields, barriers, drains) shown on the released definitions?
Are any segregation shortfalls justified and approved?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
